mechanism: Nafcillin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces voriconazole concentrations, compromising antifungal efficacy; voriconazole may also inhibit nafcillin metabolism to a minor degree.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, consider alternative antifungal (liposomal amphotericin B, echinocandin) or increase voriconazole dose and monitor voriconazole levels closely.
